protocol.preprocessing: training-only median, population scale, clipping standardized features at +/-5; no imputation of missing raw prices or peer rows
protocol.purge: training target_end strictly before validation origin-year; validation target_end within year; calibration targets fully inside calibration window
protocol.embargo: no additional embargo: strictly matured labels; 30-row nonoverlap scoring; remaining time dependence handled descriptively by shared-quarter blocks

selection.rule: candidate must beat every declared appropriate baseline by paired shared-quarter upper loss bound below zero at Bonferroni-adjusted level across 3 candidates x 3 baselines, and beat the best baseline in at least 3/4 years; else best baseline

uncertainty.update: development OOF residuals only after target_end < next origin; no outcome refitting of point model; no method selection on 2021-2023 calibration

admission.reason: No confirmatory holdout in this development study. Independent complete data/rights review and a separately registered fresh prospective study are mandatory. Development selection alone never authorizes deployment.

limitations: Known vendor calendar and adjustment defects remain; no exchange-complete session claim

notes: Same pinned third-party Yahoo/yfinance artifacts and hashes as the original study; no new provider validation is implied.
Study inputs crop uniformly to 2010-01-01 through 2025-12-31. Final point-model refit includes matured 2010-2020 data; the spent 2019-2020 test is now development data.
Initial model validation reuses the exploratory 2016-2017 development folds. Choose feature models only when paired quarter-cluster loss improvements are supported; otherwise keep the best baseline.

Adjusted return target spans 30 observed positive-volume vendor rows. Exchange calendar completeness is not independently established; older expected Muhurat dates may be absent. Do not describe it as a guaranteed complete 30-session exchange calendar.

Causal scale uses max(past 20/past 60 row volatility)*sqrt(30), floored at the development-only 5th percentile. Per-security normalized residual ranks use 2021-2023; never use fresh test outcomes for tuning.

Frozen primary interval is security_vol_scaled. Pooled absolute, per-security absolute and joint date-max standardized alternatives are declared comparators, not candidates selected after test scoring.
Five stocks are present-day survivors; price-only research cannot validate five-agent personalized actions or authentic historical filings.

The archive was created September 18, 2026 according to cached repository metadata; the entire 2021-2025 study extension predates the incremental-update boundary. Adjustment vintage and provider authenticity remain limitations.

Zero-volume holiday placeholders are uniformly excluded, positive-volume weekend observations retained. Cached full raw files include a missing latest-2026 close outside this predeclared window; nothing inside the study is silently imputed.
